title: 15 USDC commercially useful frontier — Generate externally funded canonical GMV
summary: Buy useful digital work from a different eligible wallet during the announced week. The entrant who generates the highest eligible pro-rata canonical GMV wins 15 USDC.
objective: Create real marketplace demand and useful completed work while giving the winning entrant a positive cash margin at practical child-bounty budgets.
creator: 0x884834e884d6e93462655a2820140ad03e6747bc

economics.profit_warning: Winning is not guaranteed. Entrants separately choose and fund useful child work. The winner prize does not reimburse that spend, but every entrant keeps the completed work it purchased.

one_usdc_child_example.value_received: The entrant receives the completed one-USDC child deliverable whether or not it wins.

three_usdc_child_example.value_received: The entrant receives the completed three-USDC child deliverable whether or not it wins.

participation_economics.boundary: Examples exclude Base gas and the entrant's labor. A completed child bounty is a purchased deliverable, not a refundable stake.

task_rules: Choose digital work that you or another real external poster genuinely wants completed; self-dealing and synthetic volume score zero.
Use the entrant wallet to post and canonically fund one or more useful marketplace bounties during the scoring window.
A different eligible wallet must complete each child task and receive canonical settlement before the window closes.
There is no artificial 3-USDC minimum for one child bounty. Choose budgets that match useful work, but generate at least 1.00 USDC of total attributable canonical GMV to qualify.
Score equals settlement GMV multiplied by the entrant wallet's canonical funding divided by total canonical funding.
Operator or reserve funding, excluded reward contracts, creator-as-solver rows, entrant-as-solver rows, and noncanonical activity score zero.
The highest score at or above 1.00 USDC of attributable canonical GMV wins; an equal score does not replace the earlier accepted proof.
You keep the completed child deliverable if you do not win, but only one competition winner receives the 15-USDC prize.
activation_condition: The competition is active only after a safe-block canonical projection reports the full 15040000 base units funded and CompetitionActivatedV2.
payment_evidence: Only a safe-block CompetitionSettledV2 event proves the solver was paid.
authorization_boundary: This reviewed artifact contains no signature and authorizes no transaction or spending.
